name: pstack-zcode
description: The whole pstack collection for ZCode, adapted from Lauren @poteto's workflow: all 54 skills plus an optional poteto-mode summary hook, off by default. One install carries everything. npx skills add stays available for a skills-only install.

summaryAtStart.title: Poteto-mode summary
summaryAtStart.description: When on, every new session starts with the condensed poteto-mode summary, about 300 tokens. Off by default.
